learning_outcomes.text: Students know the peculiarities in the chemical structure of non-metals (plastics and ceramics).
They can apply processing methods appropriate to the material.
They can determine the most important material characteristic values.
Students can evaluate the application possibilities and limits of the various non-metals.
They can select non-metals based on technical-economic and sustainable aspects.

syllabus_topics: Laboratory experiments on plastic processing and material characterization or excursion
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module exam. The weighting for the final grade is based on credit points.
bibliography: All documents (script, exercise materials, etc.) are provided digitally via the e-learning platform. Secondary literature is available as an e-book:
Moeller – Handbuch Konstruktionswerkstoffe, Hanser Verlag, München
Schaeffer – Werkstoff Glas, Springer Verlag Berlin
